messages:
Devin (AE): Quick sync — Acme pilot: need to lock POC acceptance gates, SE shifts, and identify any enterprise blockers (security + data residency). Can we align owners and a 4-week runway?

Ana S: I can cover week1-2 for integration + latency tests. Need sample prompt sets and eval metrics.

Riley - PM: Proposed success criteria: 95th pctile latency < 450ms, macro F1 > 0.78 on eval set, cost <= $0.015/token for inference budget. Also track hallucination rate < 3% per eval. Thoughts?

Mika (Security): Security Q done but waiting on customer to sign AAD SSO config. Also need network diagram and KMS key policy. Pinged them.

Jordan (CS): Customer confirmed they're sending PII-free sample data by tomorrow. They want canary traffic on day 14.

Sam (Eng): For canary, we need a dedicated capacity slot — request is 4xA10g for 3 hours/day — SEs ok with that? Hosting or Dedicated?

Ana S: Dedicated would be ideal for predictability. If hosted, we'll need quota bump. Can we schedule with infra?

Devin (AE): @Sam can you confirm availability and an estimate on procurement time? Also pricing question: how to quote burst capacity for canary?

Sam (Eng): I'll check. For pricing, we suggest quoting base reserved + one-off burst credit bucket. I'll put numbers after infra check.

Alex (Solutions): Quick note on evals: Send 200 labeled prompts across 4 intents + edge QA set. We'll run eval harness and produce precision/recall + confusion matrix. I can prep a shared notebook.

Riley - PM: Timeline draft:
```
Week 0: access + security signoffs, dataset upload
Week 1: integration + ingest prompts, baseline eval
Week 2: latency/cost tuning + canary prep
Week 3: canary run + capture metrics
Week 4: final acceptance + handover
```
Need owners per line.

Devin (AE): Owners: Security: Mika, Infra: Sam, SE Integration: Ana, Evals+notebook: Alex, CS coordination: Jordan, PM: Riley.

Mika (Security): Also flag: customer requires HSM-backed KMS for keys in production. That will add ~2 weeks if they insist. Confirm asap.

Jordan (CS): Customer indicated KMS is optional for pilot but required for prod. They said pilot can use managed keys.

Sam (Eng): Good — that reduces lead time. I'll tentatively reserve dedicated capacity for week3 canary; confirm later.

Ana S: One blocker: we need their prompt schema and redaction rules. @Devin can you get that by EOD?

Devin (AE): On it — asked legal and PM. Will push.

Riley - PM: Action items summarized:
```
- Devin: get prompt schema + customer POI consent (EOD)
- Mika: finish SSO/KMS checklist (48h)
- Sam: capacity check & pricing model (48h)
- Alex: prepare eval notebook (3d)
- Ana: integration runbook + test scripts (4d)
- Jordan: confirm data delivery date (EOD)
```
We'll reconvene Thu 11am PT.

Devin (AE): Thu 11am PT works. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
